summary: Reproduced the base source ordering in which ready_to_load_host_cache hands over the HiCache burst before prepare_for_extend and the remaining round-head uploads. Moved the hand-over to run_batch after final batch formation, pre-uploaded forward inputs and metadata before the burst event, and consumed staged tensors once with source-identity guards. The correction matches open upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38449 and was independently validated on the prepared base.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression collection proved the required staging/order API was absent; source inspection recorded ready_to_load_host_cache before prepare_for_extend.

21 issue-specific ordering and boundary cases: pre-upload-before-hand-over, pure and mixed prefill, speculative and DP metadata behavior, one-shot identity-guarded consumption, cache-disabled and non-extend gating, idempotent re-entry, and merge invalidation.
56 focused scheduler, DP MLP-sync, auxiliary-output, and issue regression tests passed.

tests.command: prepared Python inline torch.cuda pinned-H2D StagedDeviceTensor check
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, copied [3,5,8] from pinned host memory and verified one-shot consumption and source-identity rejection.
No whitespace errors in the proposed patch.

gpu_execution.evidence: A real pinned nonblocking H2D staging and consumption check passed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-).

remaining_limitations: The reported timing-dependent production symptom was observed upstream on 8x H100 TP=8 with multi-GiB host-cache bursts. This job had one gfx950 GPU and no qualifying large model weights/workload, so it did not reproduce or profile the H100 copy-engine arbitration, TP all-reduce delay, multi-GiB HiCache burst, or end-to-end performance change. The GPU check validates staging mechanics only; deterministic unit tests validate the stream-enqueue call order. No native C++ code changed.
